verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an MCP server it runs (https://git.cafe/mcp) and exposes those tools to browser agents via WebMCP. Both are the server role: they give tools to external AI clients, so they do not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows GitCafe itself connecting to or consuming third-party MCP servers. A forge with built-in agent features could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
